concerns.text: The plan flags studies with effective N < 50 as exploratory, yet the power analysis (Phase 8) estimates only ~0.6 power to detect an effect size of r≈0.3 after BH correction. This sample size is marginal for reliable inference, especially given multiple‑testing and phylogenetic adjustment. Recommend either increasing the target species count (e.g., ≥ 80) or tempering the expected effect size/power thresholds.

OLS includes only a family covariate. Potential ecological confounders (e.g., plant size, geographic region, experimental protocol) are not modeled, which could bias the estimated metabolite‑herbivory relationships. Suggest either collecting/including such covariates or explicitly acknowledging this limitation in the reporting phase.

Correlation is computed on metabolite‑class averages ("averaged across compounds"). Averaging may mask within‑class heterogeneity and could weaken construct validity of the ‘class’ predictor. Consider reporting both class‑level and compound‑level correlations, or justify why averaging is appropriate for the biological question.
